label_descriptions.empty-input: An empty array returns an empty array. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising empty input.
label_descriptions.no-duplicates: An array with no duplicates returns a copy with the same elements in the same order. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising the no-duplicates case.
label_descriptions.all-duplicates: An array where every element is the same value collapses to a single-element array. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising the all-same case.
label_descriptions.preserves-first-occurrence-order: When duplicates are removed, the order of remaining elements matches their first-occurrence order in the input. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising order preservation with duplicates.
label_descriptions.primitive-types-mixed: Different primitive types are deduplicated independently (1 and '1' are different, true and 1 are different). The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising mixed-primitive-types behavior.
label_descriptions.object-reference-equality: Two different object literals with the same shape are NOT considered duplicates. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising object-reference-equality.
label_descriptions.nan-deduplication: Multiple NaN entries collapse to one (NaN treated as equal to NaN for dedupe purposes). The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising NaN handling.
